title: Australian Chicken Skewers
description: Grilled chicken skewers with a unique twist, perfect for a summer evening.

ingredients.name: crunchy
ingredients.notes: crunchy slaw (made with shredded cabbage, carrots, and a hint of apple cider vinegar)

ingredients.name: australian
ingredients.notes: australian BBQ sauce (made with ketchup, brown sugar, and a hint of eucalyptus)

instructions: Thread chicken, unique seasoning, crunchy slaw, and australian BBQ sauce onto skewers.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until chicken is cooked through.
